# Complexity and systemic modeling for Human-Centered Design

## Synopsis
Is engineering a science or an applied science? What does “putting people first” mean? Designing leads to building an operational perspective on the desired reality, but how can this be achieved? The course will introduce two key concepts that are useful in design: complexity and systemic modeling. This will require us to pay particular attention to familiar words such as intention, context, and project. It will also undoubtedly lead us to take a step back, question ourselves, and reconsider our expectations regarding “truth.”
